in_marathi.name: Akshar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Immutable, imperishable, or eternal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshar refers to the eternal, immutable, and imperishable aspect of the universe, often represented as the eternal alphabet or syllabus. It is a term used in Hindu scriptures, particularly in the Rigveda, and is considered a sacred and powerful concept.
